summary: Planned /literature --rebuild in 6 single-agent-run phases: (1) literature.md mode-detection wiring for --rebuild/--dry-run; (2) handle_rebuild() scaffold in SKILL.md with absent-sub-index deferral to literature-create-setup-task.sh and a multiSelect job-picker; (3) Job 1 dangling-ref lint (wire up existing dead Validate block) + Job 2 structural-minimum schema check; (4) Job 4 per-directory chunk-coverage audit; (5) Job 3 coverage refresh (only writer, confirm-gated); (6) end-to-end verification. All edits scoped to extension source. Jobs 1/2/4 read-only; Job 2 checks structural minimums only to preserve BimodalLogic's load-bearing curation fields.

artifacts.summary: 6-phase plan (7h) for /literature --rebuild: command wiring, handle_rebuild scaffold + absent-sub-index deferral + job-picker, then the four jobs (dangling-ref lint, structural-minimum schema check, per-directory coverage audit, confirm-gated coverage refresh), then verification against cslib/BimodalLogic/nvim.

decisions_made: Job 2 checks structural minimums only (doc_id + relevance-or-reason); never strips/flags BimodalLogic's hazard/citation_rule/known_corrections/audits fields.
Job phases 3-5 sequenced (not parallel) because all append to handle_rebuild() in the same SKILL.md region; phases 1 and 2 parallel (different files).
Job 4 queries chunks_data not document_metadata (empty); convert-vs-ingest pipeline fix is out of scope (audit reports the gap only).
Absent sub-index (nvim) defers to literature-create-setup-task.sh; never duplicated, never errors.
